fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2025-10-25, the complainant was allegedly assaulted during an argument near Mynthan Colony Main Street in Erode, resulting in minor injuries. The time of the incident was given as 01:05 on 2025-10-23. Kishore Pandian reported the matter orally at Erode North PS; the contact number given was 9000000200. Udhay Pandian (9000000220) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Nithin Velan (9000000004), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-47-ZZ-1038 was seen leaving the area. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Saravanan Anand, using the number 9000000282.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly attacked the victim during a heated argument. A motorcycle was reportedly used to leave the area.
